mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines below 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month average unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) below 1180.0 and 525000.0 respectively indicate broad-based demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for the interaction signal remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 (index 2017=100) during manufacturing contraction regimes signals reduced output capacity, increasing recession risks and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1200.0 indicates strengthening housing market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises above 1200.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) below 0.2% and rising unemployment (UNRATE) above 3.5% signal labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for the interaction signal remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month average industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 108.5 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, increasing recession risks and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 108.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
